intro.name: Brock K. Phillips Sr.
intro.role: Nuvara founder · U.S. Army veteran · Systems builder · Author
intro.headline: I build useful systems. People stay in charge.
intro.description: I turn practical problems into AI-assisted software, documented workflows, and learning tools. My work connects infrastructure, responsible AI, education, business operations, research, and writing.
intro.background: Army counterintelligence, equipment maintenance, federal service, and youth programs taught me to understand the problem, organize the evidence, and verify the result.
intro.roleDisclosure: I set the direction, define requirements, and lead review. AI assistants support coding, drafting, analysis, and testing. Each case study explains my contribution and the current state of the work.

projectsIntro: From network labs to responsible AI tools, these projects show how I connect a practical need to a documented result.

projects.title: Nuvara platform
projects.description: A responsive public website connecting AI, learning, cybersecurity, media, and business work through a shared focus on human authority.
highlights: Organized the product areas and directed AI-assisted implementation and review.
Created public navigation, research content, inquiry intake, and a Proof Room.
Documented responsive, accessibility, route, and privacy-boundary checks.

projects.title: Core, HALO & local workforce
projects.description: Private AI operations tools that connect task execution to policies, human decisions, diagnostic evidence, and recorded outcomes.
highlights: Directed task queues, project registration, evidence receipts, and memory-review workflows.
Developed bounded local analysis tools and a bridge to Core execution.
Preserved dated acceptance records, file-integrity checks, and local AI quality findings.

projects.title: AI² & Writing Studio
projects.description: Learning and writing workflows built around original attempts, source evidence, reflection, version history, and human review.
highlights: Defined assignment policies, reasoning expectations, attribution, and learner reflection.
Implemented version saves, conflict detection, export, pause, and cancellation controls.
Retained 15 non-AI real-server checks; complete learner acceptance remains open.

projects.title: CyberTex infrastructure & cloud capstone
projects.description: Server lab direction and team cloud architecture work spanning virtualization, directory services, recovery evidence, and technical handover.
highlights: Led lab direction and evidence organization; served as Design & Standards / Cloud Architect.
Documented Proxmox networking, Active Directory/DNS health, DHCP readback, and rollback.
Produced AWS architecture standards, API contracts, responsibility records, and runbook criteria.

projects.title: SOHO departmental network
projects.description: A three-department network simulation connecting VLAN design, subnet planning, trunking, and observable gateway tests.
highlights: Designed three departmental VLANs and a /26 subnet plan.
Used a Cisco 2911 router, Cisco 2960 switch, and router-on-a-stick routing.
Retained three gateway ping checks, each showing four replies and zero lost packets.
projects.imageAlt: Illustrated three-department VLAN topology reconstructed from the reviewed project design

projects.title: Nuvara Lab Guide
projects.description: A signed local distribution and activation kit designed to verify packages, protect activation material, and keep publisher secrets out of the customer package.
highlights: Directed signed manifests, hash allowlists, encrypted activation, and device-key checks.
Built repeatable request, issuance, activation, installation, and status operations.
Retained eight validation checks including a disposable CLI journey; a second device was simulated.

projects.title: Small-business operating tools
projects.description: Two preview implementations translating menu operations, inquiry records, and service-request planning into clear customer and owner workflows.
highlights: Directed a responsive food-business website with a protected, persistent owner workspace.
Implemented consent, date validation, retry handling, and recorded payment-state summaries.
Built a dual-service planner with conditional fields, editable summaries, copy, and text download.

projects.title: Nuvara Media
projects.description: An editorial and production workflow connecting source records, rights, reviewed versions, local rendering, and publication decisions.
highlights: Defined editorial direction and directed newsroom and production implementation.
Connected scripts, sources, rights, corrections, and provider receipts to production records.
Built resumable local rendering with captions, provenance, cancellation, and resource controls.

projects.title: Research & community planning
projects.description: Research frameworks, source registers, manuscript drafts, and planning proposals connecting education, community needs, and technical organization.
highlights: Developed a coastal research agenda and framework for accountable source and claim review.
Created manuscript drafts, evaluation plans, pilot packets, and workflow proposals.
Delivered a community planning packet, retained recipient feedback, and submitted a grant application.

projects.title: The Crowned One
projects.description: My independently published paperback examines sports culture, identity, admiration, mentorship, and responsibility.
highlights: Provided the authorial direction and personal perspective, with AI-assisted editing and preparation.
Completed manuscript organization, print preparation, cover review, and paperback publication.
Published October 11, 2026; the public listing records 196 pages.

method.title: People define the purpose. Evidence establishes the result.
method.description: I start with the person, the task, and the constraints. I use tools to build and check the work, preserve source evidence, document corrections, and keep consequential decisions with the human owner.

principles.title: Understand the work
principles.description: Connect the product to the actual task, the people using it, and the constraints they face.

principles.title: Make the result inspectable
principles.description: Preserve sources, versions, checks, and outcomes so someone else can assess the work.

principles.title: Keep people in control
principles.description: Separate preparation, permission, execution, and verification in consequential workflows.
